name: State Programme For Rehabilitation Of Persons With Disabilities
benefit:
- Under this scheme, the state government will provide aids &amp; appliances such as tricycles, wheelchairs, crutches, walking sticks, Blind sticks, Rollator, and Hearing Aids to persons with disabilities.
- The state government will organize a Diagnostic Camp-cum-Free Distribution of Aids &amp; appliances at the district level from time to time.

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh. 2. An applicant with a 100% degree of disability is eligible to apply under the scheme.
